svg.title: /research:fortify
svg.desc: /research:fortify — execution architecture — runs, gates and the sequential ablation loop
svg.text: execution architecture — runs, gates and the sequential ablation loop
↺ dashed = same stage reused, see its home card
bold = key name · italic = condition, bound or opt-out
no FAN · no JOIN — every stage runs alone
snakes left → right, then right → left

g.text: worktrees/ inside it · main tree never modified
one no-<component> per candidate, ASCII slug

svg.text: PER-VARIANT LOOP · SEQUENTIAL · ONE WORKTREE AT A TIME
--venue adds one stage · --skip-run and a failed full cut it short
● own stage · ↺ same stage, see its home card · ○ absent, skipped or task deleted
each gate stops, skips or halts

g.text: out of scope · no finished run · nonlocal compute
no APPROVED verdict for this program
candidates file missing or empty on notification
pwd is not the variant worktree
full mean outside max(2%, 2σ_full) of best_metric
full row absent or not completed
No FAN, no JOIN · CANDIDATES ▣ and REVIEWER Q&A ▣ each dispatch one research:scientist
background · checked post-hoc against a 15-min deadline
Variants never spawn: strictly sequential · parallel worktrees would conflict
cost ≈ (components + 1) × N metric runs + one guard run per variant
stale worktree → CLEANUP first, then WORKTREE
revert conflict → revert-conflict, not an error
metric timeout → status timeout, retried on resume
interrupt → cd ORIG_DIR, prune, re-run SWEEP
--max-ablations M → top M−1 + full; dropped ones listed
--runs 1 → no σ; threshold = 2% noise floor alone
Diagram only — SKILL.md is normative; update both with any step/gate/fan-out change.
